verdict.rationale: xAI documents a default 30-day retention policy alongside self-serve Zero Data Retention (ZDR) toggleable per team, with programmatic confirmation via an `x-zero-data-retention` response header, giving users concrete control and visibility over data retention/deletion. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that ZDR behaves as documented and explicit documentation of a user-initiated data deletion workflow beyond retention toggling.
